whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Mood Light Cafe,

I noticed your cafe has fantastic 4.6★ reviews from over 1,100 customers in Boring Road, but currently lacks a dedicated mobile website for table reservations and food menus.

Maine aapke cafe ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp table booking, interactive menu, aur rooftop ambience gallery integrate ki hai:

🔗 https://moodlightcafe-demo.arclane.workers.dev

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team Mood Light Cafe, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke cafe (Mood Light Cafe) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya?
